title: Show HN: I built Otis, a minimal AI agent that runs local models out of the box
summary: Otis is an open-source minimal AI agent designed for privacy-focused users, providing an easy setup experience for running local and hosted open-weight AI models. It automatically detects hardware, recommends suitable local models, downloads them, and runs inference through llama.cpp, while also supporting Ollama, LM Studio, and Nvidia PAIR integrations.
problem_solved: Eliminates the technical complexity of setting up and running local AI models by providing automatic hardware detection and one-click model deployment.
why_valuable: democratizes local AI usage by removing configuration barriers while ensuring privacy through entirely local model execution.
